symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1361: `check --references` passes a `create or modify microflow` that exec refuses ("replace $Equal: the fragment declares $Different, which the microflow already has" / "the Loop at (620, 200) changes inside its body") when the new body calls a microflow the same script creates; exec writes the new callee first, then reports "Nothing was written"
cause: Same class as the 2026-10-11 finding (verdict build skipped a body calling a script-created flow); the reporter's nightly 5c321d0a (2026-10-08) predates the fix cc69904b (2026-10-11), which already resolves it for every refusal kind
test: mdl/executor/validate_flow_verdicts_1361_pedapp_test.go — both reported refusal shapes, variant A (no call) and B (call to a flow the script creates); stubbing declaredFlow's scriptFlows lookup makes every B fail with the body reported unpredicted ('microflow not found in the project') and no violation, A unaffected. CLI on a PedApp copy: check exits 1 with the MDL-V1-REBUILD error, exec refuses before writing the callee
insight: Before reproducing, `git merge-base --is-ancestor <fix> <reporter's nightly hash>`: the nightly name carries the commit, and a report filed two days before a fix of the same class is most likely that fix. The earlier fix only tested the "still used by" refusal; the refusal kind does not matter (the gap is the build, not the verdict), but pinning the reported shapes is what lets the issue be closed on evidence
